tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: the conversation column, the brief.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised things on canvas: decision cards, the composer, the rail, dialogs, tables.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: receipts when expanded, the user's own message bubble, table headers, hover fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between items and around cards. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and the composer (≥3:1 on canvas and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, domain labels, receipts, helper text — on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (tooltips, the send button when idle-dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Daydor teal — the voice of the agent system: the Daydor avatar, live activity, the brief's 'done' marks, admin primary buttons. As text, on surface, canvas or brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand text; selected rail item; Daydor's highlighted summary line.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The white-label slot: primary buttons, links and selection in the employee app. Daydor themes alias it to brand; a client theme overrides only the four action tokens. Must hold 4.5:1 against surface and against on-action.

tokens.name: action-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of action fills.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind action text.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — follows action.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Never themed by a client (≥3:1 on canvas, surface, surface-sunken).

tokens.name: irreversible
tokens.usage: Write class 'irreversible' — money out, statutory filings, access revocation. The ONE loud colour in the system: the lock marker on a decision, the irreversible label, the confirm step. Text on surface or irreversible-soft.

tokens.name: irreversible-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the irreversible label and the confirm strip in a dialog.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, paid, filed, done. Text and icons on surface or success-soft; always with a word and an icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, due soon, needs a look. Text and icons on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and deadline chips under 3 days.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected, overdue, failed, blocked. Text on surface or danger-soft; as a fill with on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger badges.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Processing, write class 'guarded', informational notes. Text on surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges.

tokens.name: photo-ground
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind photographed content (receipt photos, uploaded IDs) — always dark so the photo reads as a photo, in every theme. Never put text on it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The brief's greeting. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Decision card titles, dialog titles, section heads.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: I've computed October payroll for 14 people. Two numbers moved more than usual — details below.
styles.usage: Message bodies in the conversation. Longer line height for prose.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: UI text: cards, rail, tables, forms.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Domain label above a message or card; section labels in the brief and rail.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The key figure on a decision card or brief. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Run IDs, audit IDs, PAN, UAN, IFSC, challan numbers.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous by default: whitespace is how the UI stays calm as agents add work.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in buttons; eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons in a row; rail item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between rail items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Decision card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between messages in the conversation; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between brief sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of the brief; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rail items, message bubbles' tight corner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Decision cards, receipts, tables, dialogs, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, live dots, the send button.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Decision cards and the composer — just enough lift over canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the composer while focused.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside cards, rail and receipts.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones; minimum touch target.

tokens.name: conversation-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the conversation column and the brief.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the decisions-and-runs rail on desktop.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a single-column form.
